tasks.description: User can see copyright text on all application pages - Create Footer component with dynamic year calculation and conditional visibility
tasks.why: Provides legal copyright notice and brand identification across the entire application as required by the feature spec
tasks.implementation_notes: Create src/Footer.jsx component with '© [current year] RELAY. All rights reserved.' text. Implement dynamic year using JavaScript Date object with static 2024 fallback when JS fails. Add conditional rendering to hide in modal overlays (help drawer, category picker). Style using existing theme.js tokens (small font, muted color, center-aligned). Integrate into App.jsx layout with singleton pattern to prevent duplicates during navigation. Position at bottom using CSS flexbox. Component should be self-contained and not interfere with existing UI elements like floating action buttons.
tasks.contract_references: No API contract changes required - frontend-only feature
acceptance_criteria: Copyright text '© [current year] RELAY. All rights reserved.' appears on all application pages
Text is positioned at bottom of each page in footer area
Text uses small font size and muted color from theme tokens
Year automatically displays current year using JavaScript Date.getFullYear()
Static HTML fallback displays '© 2024 RELAY. All rights reserved.' when JavaScript fails
Footer is hidden in modal overlays (help drawer, category picker)
Footer prevents duplicate instances during rapid navigation
Footer uses existing design system tokens for visual consistency
Footer does not interfere with existing bottom-positioned UI elements

decisions: Single wave approach: Since this is frontend-only with no API changes, all work can be completed in one self-contained task that delivers the complete user story
150 line estimate includes: Footer component (~40 lines), comprehensive test suite (~60 lines), App.jsx integration (~20 lines), conditional rendering logic (~15 lines), error handling (~15 lines)
No shared infrastructure needed: Feature is completely self-contained with existing design system providing all required styling tokens
Medium priority matches feature spec priority - this is not blocking other development but provides required legal/branding compliance
